A new page for after the meeting, find & replace in the transcript, and a prompt to record when a call starts.

**After the meeting** (#659)

- A recording now opens on one header (name, where it's filed, Connect AI, Copy) over tabs: Summary, Follow-ups, Notes, Meeting background, Scores and Replay. It replaces the single long report.
- The title is named for you when the recording is filed. Click it, or the pencil, to rename it. Folder suggestions stay suggestions: pick one, choose another, or leave it unfiled.
- Summary reads one section at a time (highlights, decisions, open questions…), cut from the saved brief, so switching sections costs no extra analysis.
- Follow-ups say which side does each item (us or them) and who, grouped by side, with a copy button per side that pastes cleanly into LINE or email. Items made before sides existed say so and offer to regenerate.
- Summary and follow-ups are generated once and kept; they only regenerate when you ask.
- Connect AI shows the MCP command, the Claude Desktop config, a live status and example questions about this recording. Copy names the tab it copies, and works on organization recordings too.

**Find & replace in the transcript** (#659)

- Press ⌘⌥F (Ctrl+Alt+F on Windows) for a find bar with a replace row, step through matches with ↑↓, and replace one or all. Or select text and choose Replace….
- Edits are saved to the recording and synced. After a fix, Parley offers to add the word to your dictionary, and to rerun the analysis that was built on the old text.
- Organization recordings are read-only here, so they have no replace.

**Ask to record when a call starts** (#659)

- When another app starts using the microphone, a small prompt appears at the top right offering to record the meeting, or to record a meeting draft that's due within 15 minutes. It closes on its own after 20 seconds.
- You can mute it for a specific app. It never appears while Parley is recording or dictating, and it ignores dictation tools.
- Turn it off in Settings: "Remind me to record when a call is detected".

**Voice typing cues** (#659)

- Voice typing plays a short system sound when it starts listening and another when it stops. Meeting recordings stay silent.

**Organizations and library** (#659)

- Organization pages show their folders as cards with a New folder card, the organization's meeting drafts, and recordings not yet in a folder.
- The whole recording row is clickable and shows that it's opening. Organization recordings open right away while the audio downloads, and their analysis now runs once instead of on every open.
- The floating window can be minimized to the Dock or taskbar, or shrunk to the draggable mini window. Meeting-draft reminders are now a system notification only.
